name: Giant Squid
heading: SQUID, GIANT
sourceWitness: The original RTF controls the rule summary. The Hypertext d20 SRD is a readable view.
appearanceEvidence: The SRD describes a squid with a body that can exceed 20 ft. The mantle, club tips, and colors are editorial details in the new portrait.
habitatEvidence: The printed Environment row is Temperate aquatic.
printingNotes: The combat table calls all ten appendage attacks tentacles. The portrait distinguishes the eight arms from the two longer feeding tentacles.
Grapple +29 equals +9 base attack, +8 Strength, +8 Huge size and +4 racial. The creature entry gives no ink-cloud duration.
